mode: explicit local import only; no live source connected
formats: UTF-8 NDJSON of grouped progress/final records

metadata.label: Optional human-readable name, 1–120 characters
metadata.implementation: Optional: direct-quic, rust-rust or go-rust; declared, not verified
metadata.payload_bytes: Optional: 1024 or 16384. A final record supplies its own payload shape.

optional_envelope.records: An ordered array of unchanged grouped progress/final objects; no invented fields or synthetic measurement values

rules: Every snapshot starts at window 1 and contains contiguous intervals from source time zero.
Each artifact remains independent. No filename-based merging or automatic run identity inference.
A final marker must reconcile with the last progress window. Silence never means completed or failed.
A syntactically cut-off final NDJSON line can be retained as a partial tail, after complete progress records; duplicate keys or invalid complete JSON are quarantined.
No other stdout diagnostic schemas are accepted in this release. Export only the reviewed grouped records.
Payload rate is bidirectional application payload, not interface traffic or per-direction throughput.
Timestamps are relative to the source clock; receipt time is not a benchmark timestamp.
Do not export credentials, private TLS material, host identifiers or unrelated logs.
No source watcher, exporter or VM connection is installed or activated. Any future connection needs a reviewed source and authorization.
